selection.edition: international Acuity Scheduling REST API v1
selection.ownership: Acuity Scheduling is a Squarespace, Inc. product (8 Clarkson St, New York, NY). The reviewed edition is the public HTTPS API at acuityscheduling.com/api/v1, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official Acuity Scheduling REST API v1 (HTTP Basic with numeric User ID as username and API Key as password, GET /me, GET /calendars, GET /appointment-types, GET /forms, GET /appointments), Squarespace ownership, privacy/security help, status-page outages, and dated incident search for Acuity Scheduling / Squarespace Scheduling security breach/incident reviewed on 2026-09-13. Status-page items in 2026 are availability incidents, not customer-data compromises. No qualifying current unresolved customer-data compromise was identified in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.

research.edition: international Acuity Scheduling REST API v1
research.searchCoverage: Official Acuity v1 Basic Auth API at https://acuityscheduling.com/api/v1 reviewed on 2026-09-13. Operator is Squarespace, Inc. (New York). Dated incident search found no qualifying unresolved customer-data compromise. Status-page events are availability incidents.

incidents.finding: Bounded search of Acuity Scheduling / Squarespace Scheduling security breach coverage on 2026-09-13 identified no current unresolved customer-data compromise. 2026 status-page items are resolved availability/maintenance events.
incidents.limitation: This is not a breach-free claim; live authentication remains unverified.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to official GET /me used by the pinned validator.
Native Basic uses http.auth.basic with stored userId as username and apiKey as password rather than a handwritten header.
Returns raw Acuity JSON under data instead of the pinned camelCase account wrapper. The upstream user-agent is not sent.
Maps to official GET /calendars. Raw JSON array is returned under data.
Maps to official GET /appointment-types. Optional includeDeleted binds to the pinned query name includeDeleted.
Maps to official GET /forms. Raw JSON array is returned under data.
Maps to official GET /appointments with optional max, minDate, maxDate, and canceled.
calendarID, appointmentTypeID, showall, client filters, excludeForms, direction, and field:id are omitted so every declared input is a single scalar query binding.
Maps to official GET /appointments/{id}. Raw JSON is returned under data.
Maps to official POST /appointments. Optional email, calendarID, phone, and notes are omitted from the body when unset.
Maps to official PUT /appointments/{id} whitelist attributes.
Maps to official PUT /appointments/{id}/cancel.
Maps to official PUT /appointments/{id}/reschedule with datetime.
Maps to official GET /appointment-types/{id}.
Maps to official GET /clients with optional max and search.
Maps to official POST /clients.
Maps to official GET /availability/dates. addonIDs[] repeated query is omitted.
Maps to official GET /availability/times.
Maps to official GET /blocks.
Maps to official POST /blocks.
Maps to official DELETE /blocks/{id}.
Maps to official GET /labels.
Maps to official GET /products.
